text: Identify what the multiplayer proposal is targeting.

The prospective networked workshop product is designed around synchronized browser sessions for two to ten teams. Its planning capacity is up to 60 learners and two facilitators. The normal session objective is 150 minutes with an upper planning limit of 180 minutes. These are design targets, not evidence that the service has been implemented or accepted.

items: The proposed service would maintain a shared room state and a durable history of bids and purchases. The HTML study app remains a separate offline learning tool.
